entities.name: Moussa Cissé
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Moussa Cissé is a Guinean professional basketball player for the Dallas Mavericks of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Texas Legends of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Memphis Tigers, Ole Miss Rebels and the Oklahoma State Cowboys. He was a consensus five-star recruit and one of the best centers in the 2020 class.
